products.title: 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box
products.description:
Factory-sealed 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball hobby box — 20 packs of 4 cards, one autograph per box, and the first Topps NBA Debut Patch Autographs of the Cooper Flagg rookie class.
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 20 packs per box
## Product highlights
- 2025/26 Topps Chrome Updates Basketball is headlined by one of the most coveted cards in the hobby: NBA Debut Patch Autographs, making their Topps Basketball debut!
- Considered a pinnacle chase across The Hobby, these 1-of-1 grails, featuring game-worn NBA Debut patches, arrive for the first time in basketball with standout rookies like Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, and Dylan Harper leading the charge!
- The chase is rounded out by superstars such as Stephen Curry, LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, Anthony Edwards, Nikola Jokić and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and more across major SSPs and Autographs!
- The 200-card base set features refreshed imagery for the rookies, vets and legends, all showcased in updated, in-season photography featuring Statement, City and Classic Edition uniforms and of course, a deep rainbow of Chrome parallels!
- Minions NBA are SSPs that reimagine NBA stars as Minions in collaboration with Illumination for a fun, highly collectible crossover insert. In addition, look out for the Denim Tears SSP parallel, and newly added Captains, Celebración case hit inserts!
- Autograph collectors can chase a robust lineup of Topps Chrome Autographs, including special appearances from Druski and Spike Lee!
- The 1980–81 Topps Basketball Autographs deliver another loaded checklist, while the ultra-cool Lava Lamp Rookie Autographs add a groovy twist!
## Box break averages
- 1 Autograph

The 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box delivers the iconic Chrome collecting experience with an exciting lineup of NBA stars, top rookies, and standout players from the season. Featuring the signature chromium finish collectors love, this release offers the chance to chase stunning refractors, autograph cards, rare inserts, and exclusive parallels. With a fresh selection of updated player content and premium Chrome designs, the 2025/26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball Hobby Box is a must-have for basketball collectors looking to add some of the hobby’s most sought-after cards to their collection.

products.title: 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football Hobby Box
products.description:
Factory-sealed 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football hobby box — 20 packs of 4 space-themed Chrome cards with Light Years, Cosmic Dust and Supernova case hits.
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 20 packs per box
## Product highlights
- 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football launches the iconic Chrome brand into orbit with a dynamic, space-inspired design that brings a fresh twist to the hobby.
- The 200-card base checklist highlights today’s top NFL talent and the league’s most exciting newcomers, giving collectors a mix of stars from every generation.
- A variety of eye-catching inserts await, including fan-favorite themes like Star Clusters and Extraterrestrial Talent, along with additional cosmic-inspired surprises.
- Be on the lookout for ultra-rare case hits such as Light Years, Cosmic Dust, and Supernova, each offering unique visual appeal and collectability.
- Collectors can chase the ambitious Planetary Pursuit set, a buildable collection that spans the entire solar system—from the blazing Sun out to distant Pluto.
- Autograph content is also a major highlight, featuring four distinct signature sets. These include on-card autographs randomly inserted throughout the product, spotlighting elite veterans, standout rookies, and the next wave of NFL stars.

Blast into a new collecting experience with the 2025 Topps Cosmic Chrome Football Hobby Box! Featuring dazzling space-inspired designs and the signature Chrome finish, this premium release showcases top rookies, star veterans, and legendary football icons in a visually stunning format. Collectors can chase vibrant parallels, exclusive inserts, and coveted autograph cards while uncovering some of the hobby’s most eye-catching designs. The latest edition of Artifacts® features a diverse 250-card base set which includes redemption cards for new-skating 2023-24 rookies. The base set breaks down as follows (subject to change):
## Product Highlights
- The latest edition of Artifacts® features a diverse 250-card base set which includes redemption cards for new-skating 2023-24 rookies. – Hard-Signed Autographs!
- 2023-24 Artifacts® features five autographed insert sets, all of which are Hobby-exclusive living sets! – Fans and collectors alike will love the Hobby-exclusive All-Star Artifacts set! – The popular Aurum Signatures cards feature retired legends, active stars and top 2023-24 rookies – all #’d to just 25. – Hunt down the bounty! (see description below) Box Break: – 4 Seriallly-#’d Base Set/Base Set Parallel Cards (Including 1 #’d to 99 or less) – 3 Autograph, Memorabilia and/or Tech Insert Cards – 1 Non-Auto/Mem Rookie Redemption Card – or Clear Cut Acetate Card
## Product Description
The latest edition of Artifacts® features a diverse 250-card base set which includes redemption cards for new-skating 2023-24 rookies. The base set breaks down as follows (subject to change):
- Regular (1-100) | Stars (101-135; #’d to 599) | Goalies (136-155; #’d to 599) | Legends (156-170; #’d to 599) | Rookies (171-200; #’d to 999) | Rookie Redemptions (201-250)
- The parallel/variant lineup is extensive and loaded with colorful, serially-#’d sets, including many with autographs and/or premium memorabilia. Even the top Rookies in the Rookie Redemption program will be featured on a full array of auto, memorabilia and auto/memorabilia cards! For a complete parallel list, see the “Product Breakdown” section below. Box Break: Each box will contain, on average, four (4) serially-#’d base set and/or base set parallel cards, including one (1) #’d to 99 or less. Hard-Signed Autographs! 2023-24 Artifacts® features five autographed insert sets, all of which are Hobby-exclusive living sets:
- Admirable Impressions: We’re adding seven new retired and active stars to this set, now in its fifth year. Each card is #’d to 24.
- Award Winners Autographs: This 15-card living set consists of veterans and retired players who have won a major NHL award. Each card, #’d to 25, will highlight the award won and some may also feature an inscription along with the hard-signed autograph..
- Esteemed Endorsements: This is the sixth year of this popular living set! Collectors can add all new retired legends and active superstars to their Esteemed Endorsements collection. Each card is #’d to 28 and some may also feature an inscription along with the hard-signed autograph.
- Signature Apparel: Signature Apparel, now in its fourth year, sports a diverse checklist consisting of legends, veteran stars and top rookies. Each card is #’d to 36 (Tier 1) or 12 (Tier 2) and features a premium patch swatch alongside the hard-signed autograph.
- Storied Scripts: Storied Scripts returns with 10 active and retired stars. Each card is #’d to 25 and may also feature an inscription along with the hard-signed autograph. This year’s Arena Artifacts set commemorates the historic Civic Arena, home to the Pittsburgh Penguins from 1967-2010. Each card in this special set #’d to 67 features a legendary Penguins player (who played in the Arena) alongside a piece of a relic from the legendary facility. Fans and collectors alike will love the Hobby-exclusive All-Star Artifacts set! Each card features an authentic game ticket relic from a notable game in the career of an active or retired superstar player. The set is serially-#’d and consists of two subsets
- Modern (1990-Present) and Vintage (1949-1989). The popular Aurum Signatures cards feature retired legends, active stars and top 2023-24 rookies
- all #’d to just 25. Collectors will be chasing the rare Aurum Signatures Duals cards #’d to just 5 and featuring some incredible pairings!
## Bounty program
– The Aurum Bounty Card Program returns with a 48-card set-within-a-set! Each card features the player etched out in Gold Light FX. The Mission
- Collect the complete 48-card Aurum Bounty set! Each card will feature a scratch-off bounty code. Achievements to Earn
- Once you’ve entered all 48 unique codes, you will be awarded Aurum Rookie Bounty cards #49 and #50. As a bonus, those who complete this mission the fastest will have a shot to earn the following bonus achievements in addition to the two rookie cards: First 3
- The first 3 collectors who collect & redeem the compete 48-card Aurum Bounty set will earn one (1) 12-card Aurum set + one (1) Aurum Autograph card + one (1) Aurum Dual Autograph card. Next 7
- The next 7 collectors who collect & redeem the compete 48-card Aurum Bounty set will earn one (1) 12-card Aurum set + one (1) Aurum Autograph card. Next 15
- The next 15 collectors who collect & redeem the compete 48-card Aurum Bounty set will earn one (1) 12-card Aurum set. All Remaining Collectors
- Anyone who completes the set after the first 25 will receive the Retro Rookie Bounty cards #49-50. Redeem all bounty cards at UpperDeckBounty.com. For more information about the bounty program, visit the site on or after release date.

Classic MVP design returns with a checklist chock-full of star veterans and rookies. This rare card is sure to be an awesome addition to any collection.

- Complete your 2023-24 Upper Deck Base Set – the most cherished and widely-collected annual set in hockey! – Finish off your Blue Dazzlers and Pink Dazzlers insert sets with the final 50 cards of the 2023-24 season.
- The checklist features several superstars! – Extended Series delivers all new and several classic Upper Deck insert sets that will catch the eye of all collectors. – Collect the 2008-09 Upper Deck retro set, including Young Guns®!
- Look for both Exclusives (#’d to 100) and High Gloss (#’d to 10) parallels as well.

products.title: 2025-26 Topps Chrome Update Series Basketball Blaster Box
products.description:
Cards To Chase: NBA Debut Patch Autographs of Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, Kon Knueppel, Ace Bailey, VJ Edgecombe, Tre Johnson III, Cedric Coward, Derik Queen, and others, on-card rookie autographs of Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, Dylan Harper, and others,…
## 2025-26 Topps Chrome Update Series Basketball Blaster Box
Configuration:
- 4 cards per pack.
- 7 packs per box.
Look for NBA Debut Patch Autographs.
Cards To Chase: NBA Debut Patch Autographs of Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, Kon Knueppel, Ace Bailey, VJ Edgecombe, Tre Johnson III, Cedric Coward, Derik Queen, and others, on-card rookie autographs of Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, Dylan Harper, and others, veteran autographs of LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, Anthony Edwards, Nikola Jokic, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and others, additional autographs of Druski and Spike Lee, super short print inserts like Alter Egos, Minions NBA Variations, and Denim Tears Parallels, short print case hit inserts like Helix, Radiating Rookies, Captains, and Celebración, new and returning inserts like New Edition, Stratospheric Stars, No Limit, Glass Canvas, Fanatical, and Moment in Time, and additional hits, inserts, variations, and parallels. Some of the cards, inserts, parallels, and sets listed here for this release may be exclusive to specific versions and configurations of the product. Please review the checklist for additional information.
2025-26 Topps Chrome Update Series Basketball is headlined by one of the most coveted cards in the hobby, Rookie Debut Patch Autographs, making their Topps Basketball debut. Considered a pinnacle chase across The Hobby, these one-of-one grails, featuring game-worn NBA Debut patches, arrive for the first time in basketball with standout rookies like Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, and Dylan Harper leading the charge. The chase is rounded out by superstars such as Stephen Curry, LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, Anthony Edwards, Nikola Jokić, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and more across major SSPs and Autographs.
Each Blaster Pack of 2025-2026 Topps Chrome Updates Basketball contains four cards. Look for autographs, Refractors, Prism Refractors, RWB Refractors, inserts, case hit inserts, and NBA Debut Patch Autographs.
The 200-card base set features refreshed imagery for the rookies, vets, and legends, all showcased in updated, in-season photography featuring Statement, City and Classic Edition uniforms and of course, a deep rainbow of Chrome parallels. Collectors can also hunt a wide range of new inserts including New Edition, Stratospheric Stars, No Limit, and Moment in Time, highlighting iconic NBA moments like Curry’s “Ring Me” celebration in the NBA Finals.
Beyond the Rookie Debut Patch Autographs, chase elements run deep with exciting case hits like the NBA’s first Alter Egos SSPs, an epic 10-card set that transforms each player into a dynamic, illustrated, super-powered persona. Minions NBA are SSPs that reimagine NBA stars as Minions in collaboration with Illumination for a fun, highly collectible crossover insert. In addition, look out for the Denim Tears SSP parallel, and newly added Captains, Celebración case hit inserts.
Autograph collectors can chase a robust lineup of Topps Chrome Autographs, including special appearances from Druski and Spike Lee. The 1980–81 Topps Basketball Autographs deliver another loaded checklist, while the ultra-cool Lava Lamp Rookie Autographs add a groovy twist. Chrome Updates Basketball is a must-have release, bursting with star power, innovation, and true hobby heat.
Topps Chrome Updates brings the season to life with dynamic, refreshed photography, capturing the biggest stars and rising rookies in their latest looks. Chrome Updates expands on the flagship Chrome lineup with new additions and timely storytelling from across the league. Built on the signature shine, premium feel, and dynamic design collectors expect from Topps Chrome, Updates delivers a remix that keeps The Hobby aligned with the current moment.

## Configuration

## Product description
The 2025 Topps Disneyland 70th Anniversary Hobby Box celebrates seven decades of magic, memories, and iconic attractions from Disneyland with a beautifully designed trading card collection honoring the park’s rich history. Collectors can explore cards featuring beloved characters, classic rides, vintage park moments, and modern-day experiences that have made Disneyland a global destination since 1955. The set includes eye-catching inserts, special anniversary-themed parallels, and the chance to find limited autographs and rare collectibles tied to Disney’s legacy.
Commemorate 70 years of The Happiest Place on Earth with 2025 Topps Disneyland 70th Anniversary, a trading card product celebrating Disneyland’s rich history of attractions, characters, cast members, and more! Chase autographs, sketches, relics, and even a grand prize trip to Disneyland in this truly magical collecting experience.
What are you chasing?
Base Cards – Then/Now: The park’s most iconic locations and attractions are brought to life by showcasing how they’ve evolved through the decades.
Base Cards – Timeline:
– Celebrate unforgettable moments and events that shaped Disneyland’s history.
Base Cards – Snack Time:
– A playful and mouthwatering twist to the set, spotlighting the park’s most beloved snacks that have become just as legendary as the attractions themselves.
Foil Parallels:
– Foil parallels are numbered from /199 down to 1/1.
Base Cards – Concept Art:
– Pull back the curtain to reveal early concept art of some of the park’s most beloved elements.
Posters:
– Showcasing a selection of classic attraction posters from throughout the park’s history, modern collectors can experience how these iconic Disney experiences were first presented to guests.
1954 Disneyland on Wheels:
– 1954 Topps Disneyland on Wheels pairs iconic Disneyland ride vehicles from across the years with the classic 1954 Topps World on Wheels design, celebrating the engineering and imagination that bring the park’s attractions to life.
1955 Disneyland Icons:
– 1955 Topps Disneyland Icons pairs beloved Disneyland characters with the iconic Topps 1955 baseball card design, commemorating the year the park first opened its gates. Collect a selection of characters including Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey, Winnie the Pooh, Indiana Jones, and more!
Greetings from the Tiki Room Chrome:
– Greetings from the Tiki Room Chrome features the colorful birds from Walt Disney’s Enchanted Tiki Room, paired with a fun, postcard-inspired design. Each card blends tropical charm, classic attraction characters, and eye-catching shine into a standout collectible.
From Silver Screen to Main Street:
– This magical set features parades from over the years that turned Disney stories into live experiences on Main Street, U.S.A.
A Pirate’s Life Chrome:
– Plunge into the world of Disneyland’s Pirates of the Caribbean, featuring fan-favorite characters and those immortalized in the ride’s iconic entrance murals. With a vibrant Chrome finish, each card delivers bold color and high-impact presentation worthy of this legendary attraction.
Attraction Autographs:
– Chase authentic autographs from talent who voice iconic Disneyland characters or narrate memorable aspects of the park. Look for autographs of Tim Allen, Margaret Kerry, and more!

The 2026 Topps Disney Neon Hobby Box delivers a vibrant, high-energy take on Disney trading cards, combining bold neon aesthetics with premium Chrome-inspired technology for a truly unique collecting experience.
## Configuration
5 cards per pack, 20 packs per box
## Product highlights
- The action-packed, thrilling, and laugh-out- loud side of Disney is here to excite with the first-ever Topps cards of characters from Phineas and Ferb, Epic Mickey, Descendants, and Gargoyles!
- 2026 Topps Disney Neon will feature big chase hits along with autographs, one-of-a-kind sketches, and classic comic cuts!
- Chrome collectors will be energized by the Chrome Etch variation of half of the base cards and the Chrome Etch Autographs, both a perfect blend of the Topps technology with the neon colorways and kinetic imagery Disney Neon offers!
- And, for the biggest Mickey and Friends fans, look out for the Sensational Six Triple Autograph Booklet Superfractors!
## Box break averages
- 2 #’d Base/Insert Parallels
- 1 Neon PETG Lights Card
- 3 Chrome Neon Etch Base Cards
## Product description
The 2026 Topps Disney Neon Hobby Box delivers a vibrant, high-energy take on Disney trading cards, combining bold neon aesthetics with premium Chrome-inspired technology for a truly unique collecting experience. Each box includes 20 packs with 5 cards per pack and features 2 numbered base or insert parallels, 1 Neon PETG Lights card, and 3 Chrome Neon Etch base cards per box, offering a strong mix of hits and eye-catching designs in every rip.

## Configuration
10 cards per pack, 6 packs per box
## Product highlights
- The first ever Premier League Finest collection marks the debut of an iconic Topps sub-brand with a rich legacy. Delivering a vibrant mix of iconic design, modern edge and premium cards!

The 2025/26 Panini Prizm FIFA Soccer Hobby Box delivers one of the hobby’s most recognizable chromium-style soccer releases, showcasing top stars and rising talents from clubs around the world with Panini’s signature Prizm technology.
## Configuration
12 cards per pack, 12 packs per box
## Product highlights
- Prizm FIFA soccer is coming in an all-club format for the 2025-26 season!
- Collect a 300-card base set featuring players from over 25 clubs from around the globe, including Flamengo, CF Monterrey, Liverpool FC, Real Madrid, and more!
- Look for 5 numbered Prizms per box, on average, including Purple Wave (#’d/49), White Lazer (#’d/25) and Genesis!
- The autograph roster for the 2025-26 edition includes Kylian Mbappe, Lionel Messi, Christian Pulisic, Lamine Yamal and more!

The 300-card base set highlights players from more than 25 global clubs.

products.title: 2025 Topps Pixar 30 Years of Toy Story Hobby Box
products.description:
Celebrate three decades of one of Pixar’s most beloved franchises with the 2025 Topps Pixar 30 Years of Toy Story Hobby Box!
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 8 packs per box
## Product highlights
- Celebrate three decades of the beloved Toy Story franchise with 2025 Topps 30 Years of Toy Story, a trading card set that captures the heart, humor, and imagination of Woody, Buzz, and all of Andy’s unforgettable toys.
- Featuring unique inserts, sketch cards from Pixar animators, Base Card variations, Shadowbox cards, autograph cards from Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, and more, this product delivers a collectible experience packed with nostalgia, playful surprises, and the magic of Toy Story storytelling.
## Box break averages
- 1 Sketch/Autograph Card
- 4 #’d Base/Insert Parallels
- 1 Base Card Image Variation
- 8 Inserts
## Product description
Celebrate three decades of one of Pixar’s most beloved franchises with the 2025 Topps Pixar 30 Years of Toy Story Hobby Box! This special release honors the legacy of Toy Story with a colorful collection of cards featuring iconic characters, memorable moments, and artwork spanning all four films and beyond. Collect base cards, inserts, parallels, and rare hits showcasing Woody, Buzz Lightyear, Jessie, and the rest of the Toy Story crew. A perfect product for Pixar fans, Disney collectors, and trading card enthusiasts looking to relive the magic of an all-time animated classic.
Specific Tech
– Andy’s Cards recreates a familiar film setting using shadowbox technology to build a layered scene that makes it appear as though the characters are right at home in Andy’s room.
Case Hits
-Al’s Toy Barn brings the wild energy of Toy Story 2 to life with cards designed to look like one of Al’s over the top TV ads.
Short Prints
– Sid Has Your Cards imagines what would happen if the neighborhood menace from Toy Story got his hands on your collection!
– This insert features chaotic designs that look scribbled on, cut up, and totally “customized” by Sid himself.
Character Collecting
– The Base Set features an assortment of popular characters from across the Toy Story film franchise, giving collectors a vibrant mix of toys from every era of the beloved series.
Autographs
– You’ve Got a Friend in Me Autograph Edition celebrates the unforgettable friendships at the heart of Toy Story, pairing two beloved characters together on one card with signatures from the actors behind the voices.
– Look for dynamic autograph combinations featuring Tom Hanks and Tim Allen and more!
Base Card Variations
– Image Variations feature unique and playful alternate imagery for select Base Set characters that adds a fun, collectible twist to the set.
– Look out for Pizza Planet, Cone, Pixar Ball and standard Image Variations!

products.title: 2026 Topps Star Wars Chrome Galaxy Hobby Box
products.description:
The 2026 Topps Star Wars Chrome Galaxy Hobby Box brings the beloved Star Wars universe to life with a stunning chrome-style release featuring iconic characters, unforgettable artwork, and legendary moments from across the galaxy.
## Configuration
4 cards per pack, 18 packs per box
## Product highlights
- Topps Chrome Star Wars Galaxy returns with a fresh new release that celebrates the saga’s rich artistic legacy through the premium look and feel of Chrome technology!
- The 100-card base set blends unforgettable Star Wars Galaxy artwork from years past with newly created illustrations made specifically for this collection, giving collectors a wide-ranging tribute to the franchise’s visual history!
- This release also brings back several fan-favorite art-driven programs. Art of the Dark Side returns with newly commissioned artwork from Turin Clarke, while Topps Chrome Layers Original Art cards are back with a new focus on concept art from legendary Star Wars artist Doug Chiang!
- Christian Benavides also returns with his Shogun-inspired style, this time reimagining the unforgettable Cloud City duel between Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker!
- The beloved Knights of the Old Republic video game receives its own dedicated insert, featuring artwork by Gal Or. Shanne Grammar brings a bold mural and spray- paint-inspired approach to some of Star Wars’ greatest Light Side and Dark Side characters in the debut of the Force Energy insert!
- Collectors will also find autographs from notable Star Wars talent, with signatures falling one per case. Combining classic imagery, new original artwork, Chrome innovation, and characters from across the saga, this release offers a sweeping celebration of Star Wars storytelling across generations!
- Look for Numbered Parallels, Mini-Diamond Parallels, and Force Energy cards
## Box break
- 1 Autograph
- 3 Sketch Cards
## Product description
The 2026 Topps Star Wars Chrome Galaxy Hobby Box brings the beloved Star Wars universe to life with a stunning chrome-style release featuring iconic characters, unforgettable artwork, and legendary moments from across the galaxy. Collectors can chase rare Chrome parallels, stunning inserts, autograph cards from Star Wars favorites, and beautifully designed cards inspired by the original Galaxy series. Topps Finest Football returns with its signature chrome finish, bold designs, and loaded checklist featuring the NFL’s biggest stars, top rookies, and legendary players.
## Configuration

## Product highlights
- Topps Finest Football is back, bringing the unmistakable energy of the 90s to a new generation of Collectors!
- With bold designs, a premium Chrome finish, and a deep 300-card Base Set, you’ll find the game’s biggest stars, all-time legends, and rising rookies across tiered levels, each packed with vibrant parallels made for the chase!
- Inserts are at the heart of Finest, delivering the thrill that’s defined the brand for decades. Fan-favorite Centurions returns, while 1992 Finest throws it back to the very first Finest design!
- Chase iconic SSPs like The Man, Headliners, and Nightmare Fuel, plus the ultra- limited Landmark Metal Series, a new take on the fan favorite from 1995, printed on real metal!
- Autographs bring you even closer to the game, featuring top rookies, standout veterans, and legendary names!
- Look for Rookie Autos of Jaxson Dart and Cam Ward, stars like Caleb Williams and Jaxon Smith Njigba, and legends including Eli Manning and Jerry Rice!

products.title: 2025 Topps Signature Class Football Jumbo Box
products.description:
Take your football rip to the next level with the 2025 Topps Signature Class Football Jumbo Box!
## Configuration
10 cards per pack, 4 packs per box
## Product highlights
- 2025 Topps Signature Class Football features a 250-card base set highlighting top veterans and rising stars, including 150 rookies in Paper and Chrome parallels with a full range of colors!
- Available in both Hobby and Retail formats, the product offers multiple ways to collect. It introduces Short Prints like Fluidity and Roses, plus Super Short Prints such as Monarchs of the Game, Leviathans, and Odyssey!
- Autographs are led by Chrome and Crystal Clear editions, alongside subsets like Supreme Signers, Preeminent Ink, and HOF Signs, with rare Dual and Triple Autographs also in the chase!
- The checklist is packed with talent, featuring rookies like Jaxson Dart and Tetairoa McMillan, stars like Josh Allen and Jaxson Smith-Njigba, and legends including Tom Brady and Roger Staubach!
- A strong release for collectors seeking both today’s stars and all-time greats!
- Look for Paper Base, Paper Rookies, Chrome, Numbered cards, Refractors, and Inserts including Short Print Inserts!
## Box break averages
- 4 Autographs
## Product description
Take your football rip to the next level with the 2025 Topps Signature Class Football Jumbo Box! Designed for collectors chasing bigger hits and more premium content, this jumbo format delivers an exciting mix of top rookies, rising stars, and standout football talent with a strong focus on signature-driven collecting. Look for autographs, colorful parallels, exclusive inserts, and rare chase cards featuring some of the most exciting young names in the game. With more cards and more opportunities than the standard hobby format, the Jumbo Box offers even more chances to uncover major signatures, low-numbered parallels, and key rookie cards.

products.title: 2026 Topps Flagship Football Blaster 40 Box Case
products.description:
The 2026 Topps Flagship Football Blaster 40 Box Case brings the classic Topps collecting experience to football with a lineup featuring top rookies, established stars, and legendary players from across the game.
## Configuration
12 cards per pack, 6 packs per box, 40 boxes per case
## Product highlights
- For the first time in more than a decade, Topps Flagship Football returns with a fully licensed release, marking the return of one of the most iconic brands in The Hobby!
- 2026 Topps Flagship Football features a comprehensive base set showcasing the NFL’s biggest stars, rising rookies, and legend ary players!
- Look for rookie cards of Fernando Mendoza, Jeremiyah Love, and Carnell Tate alongside veteran superstars Josh Allen, Patrick Mahomes, and Joe Burrow, plus all-time greats including Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, and Drew Brees!
- A robust lineup of inserts, parallels, and Super Short Prints blends Topps heritage with modern collecting. Highlights include the debuting 1957 Rookie Variations, featuring the 2026 rookie class on the iconic 1957 Topps Football design, as well as fan favorites All Kings and Golden Mirro r Image Variations!
- Autographs and relics remain a cornerstone of the Topps Football experience, led by Flagship First Signatures, Flagship First Dual Signatures, and Super Bowl Champions Signatures!
## Product description
The 2026 Topps Flagship Football Blaster 40 Box Case brings the classic Topps collecting experience to football with a lineup featuring top rookies, established stars, and legendary players from across the game.
